free_tier.stated: no free tier: a GPU marketplace that routes each launch to the cheapest connected provider, billed per second. Live cheapest rows from its public pricing API on 2026-11-03: H100 SXM $3.99 an hour (1 GPU, us-east, 4 available); A100 80 GB $1.07 an hour (ca-central, 2 available), $1.23 (us-central) and $1.25 (us-east); L40S $0.80 an hour (us-central, 92 available) and $1.09 (eu-west). The same API call returned no RTX 4090 or L4 row with units available that day.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a GPU-hour, not an object

retention.stated: not stated in the pages read

egress.terms: not stated in the pages read

interface_detail: a REST API at api.gpu.ai/v1, a gpu CLI, Python and TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server; instances are reached over SSH. The catalog and pricing endpoints need no key.
tooling: REST API (bearer key), the gpu CLI, official Python and TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server; an instance is created with POST /v1/instances and reached over SSH. Each pricing row carries deployment_type vm or container, a tier of on_demand or spot, and an available count.
chaining: the pricing endpoint is public and priced live, so it can be polled without an account to find the cheapest A100 80 GB, L40S or H100 row before launching.

limits.value: rows are per offering with an available count (for example 92 L40S units in us-central, 2 A100 80 GB in ca-central); capacity is pooled from other providers and a row with zero units is omitted by default

limits_note: capacity is aggregated from several providers, so the available count of a row changes between reads; the docs state the on-demand server can be shared with other tenants (each on their own GPU)
binding_note: each row has a small available count, so the live stock of a given GPU in a given region is the binding number, not a time cap

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the getting-started guide says to create an account and add credit, and a deposit page shows both card deposits and USDC deposits on five chains, so a stablecoin balance is an alternative to a card. The same guide says that during private beta the browser login is internal-only and a key must be requested from the team. No signup form was read, so email is the assumed minimum and card, phone and company checks are not established.

reliability_note: unverified: the docs page is versioned V1 May 2026 and its samples were last checked against a demo environment on 2026-08-06; no status page or incident history was read
confidence_note: the prices are read from the vendor's own public pricing API on 2026-11-03; RTX 4090 and L4 appear only in the price index (reported)
